card.text: Explore Iapetus in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect Cassini imagery of Saturn’s two-toned moon and its equatorial ridge.

introduction.text: Saturn’s two-toned moon, with a dark leading hemisphere, bright icy terrain and a mountain ridge along its equator.

normal.title: Multi-mission image mosaic
normal.summary: Polar detail is coarse compared with the rest of the surface. Photographed shadows and seams remain; the grid marks gaps.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color composite
enhanced.summary: Colors extend into infrared and ultraviolet. The dark leading hemisphere is real surface material, not missing imagery.

infrared.title: Cassini VIMS flyby spectra · 10 September 2007
infrared.summary: Cassini false color: red 2.02, green 1.59, blue 1.28 µm. Coverage is partial; gray grid marks gaps. Illumination and archive filtering remain in these uncorrected measurements.

ice-absorption.title: Cassini VIMS flyby water-ice absorption · 10 September 2007
ice-absorption.summary: Near-2.02 µm water-ice absorption in partial Cassini coverage. Gray grid marks gaps. Viewing angle, grain size, noise and archive filtering affect these uncorrected values; they do not measure ice abundance.
